purpose: Fresh external-population confirmation of the unchanged seven-horizon realised-movement hypothesis on the actual 2026 SIG-mapped Polymarket universe.

hypotheses.candidate_models: Exactly the original DEV-selected model/features/hyperparameters for these seven targets from the bound TRAIN/DEV freeze. No corrected-data or DATA-003 reselection.

ordering_and_data_validity.ordering: Recover actual Polygon block_number for every DATA-003 fill tx_hash, verify block-header timestamp, then order by block_number, log_index. tx_hash may only be an impossible-tie guard after log_index.
ordering_and_data_validity.mapping_gate: 100% fill rows must map to non-null actual block_number; zero timestamp mismatches; zero duplicate (block_number,log_index) rows.
ordering_and_data_validity.window_boundary_rule: Feature lookbacks and target label endpoints may not cross DATA-003 window_id capture boundaries. Crossing observations become unsupported/missing; formulas are not altered.
ordering_and_data_validity.unavailable_feature_rule: If an original selected model feature cannot be materialized faithfully from DATA-003 without redefining its meaning or grouping, that target is INAPPLICABLE and cannot be replaced or simplified.

fit_recipe.historical_training_data: Corrected-order 005B TRAIN/DEV fit surface only; do not train on parent/corrected HOLDOUT.
fit_recipe.sampling: Reuse the original HOLDOUT evaluator fit recipe exactly, including per-family 100000-row deterministic hash ordering/limit, 300s embargo, and label-end-before-DEV gate.
fit_recipe.target_models: Reuse each target's original DEV-selected feature list, estimator name and hyperparameters exactly.

external_test.rows: All supported DATA-003 rows after exact target/feature support and window-boundary validity rules.
external_test.uncertainty: Same hierarchical market bootstrap definition as the original evaluator, with DATA-003 markets as the resampling units.

fresh_confirmation_rule.per_horizon: Candidate MAE must beat every original named baseline and hierarchical market-bootstrap lower_2_5 must be > 0.
fresh_confirmation_rule.package_level: All seven original horizons must satisfy the per-horizon rule to label the seven-horizon movement package freshly replicated on DATA-003.
fresh_confirmation_rule.partial_result: Any failures are reported as failures/partial transfer; no replacement horizon or model may be introduced.

interpretation.permitted: fresh external-population confirmation or failure of the unchanged historical movement hypothesis
prohibited: using DATA-003 to tune or select a model
introducing event-time direction as a rescue
treating replication as executable SIG profitability
